name: NCIS: Origins
description: In 1991, years prior to the events of NCIS, Leroy Jethro Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office, where he forges his place on a gritty, ragtag team led by NCIS legend Mike Franks.

videos.title: NCIS Origins Season 1: The Story Behind the Story
Season 1: Retro Crime-Solving: The Sets and Style of NCIS: Origins
Enter Sandman (1)
videos.overview: Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office, where he forges his place on a gritty ragtag team.

videos.title: Enter Sandman (2)
videos.overview: Gibbs and the gritty ragtag team continue their investigation at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office.

videos.title: Bend, Don't Break
videos.overview: A murder near Camp Pendleton leads Gibbs and the team to a suburban mall in San Diego, where Gibbs takes matters into his own hands. Jackson Gibbs pays Franks an unexpected visit.

videos.title: All's Not Lost
videos.overview: Still grieving the loss of his wife and daughter, Gibbs helps the team work a case involving a missing girl. The moment that irrevocably changed Gibbs' life is revealed.

videos.title: Last Rites
videos.overview: With the countdown on to an execution, Franks races to extricate the location of a missing body from a death row inmate and honor a promise he made to the victim's sister before time runs out.

videos.title: Incognito
videos.overview: Gibbs goes undercover for the first time with Lala as NIS works the case of a dead Navy seaman who may have been sharing top-secret intel that poses a threat to national security. Also, Lala struggles with her place on the team and an unexpected development in her personal life.

videos.title: One Flew Over
videos.overview: NIS investigates the murder of a dementia-afflicted Jane Doe. Also, flashbacks reveal the first time Gibbs met Franks

videos.title: Sick as Our Secrets
videos.overview: Gibbs and the team investigate the case of a Navy priest who was killed in the confessional booth and may have been targeted by mistake. Meanwhile, Randy shows Gibbs the ropes of working a protective detail while struggling with a personal situation.

videos.title: Vivo o Muerto
videos.overview: The case of a missing woman who disappeared after a night of clubbing with a Navy seaman takes the team to Mexico, where they learn of a possible connection to Gibbs' past.

videos.title: Blue Bayou
videos.overview: As Leroy Jethro Gibbs prepares for his first Christmas without his wife and daughter, flashbacks reveal the unlikely journey that led to his first day on the job as a special agent.

videos.title: Flight of Icarus
videos.overview: The team investigates the death of a famed Marine commander's son, while a pivotal part of Franks' past involving his family is revealed.

videos.title: Touchstones
videos.overview: When the evidence room is broken into and significant cash goes missing, the team looks into a connection to a recent case. Also, Lala opens up to Gibbs, and Kowalski struggles to move forward.

videos.title: Monsoon
videos.overview: The team investigates the brutal murder of a veteran who fell on hard times after serving in Vietnam, leading Franks to reflect on his own struggles following the war. Also, Gibbs considers a new path forward.

videos.title: To Have and to Hold
videos.overview: The team works the case of an investment advisor found dead shortly after her release from prison. Also, Mary Jo is left reeling by an unexpected development in her personal life.

videos.title: From the Ashes
videos.overview: The team investigates the brutal murder of a military sergeant found burned in her car, a case Franks suspects could have a connection to the assault of his estranged wife.

videos.title: Bugs
videos.overview: Vera receives an unexpected call from Bugs, who claims he's ready to answer more questions from prison after being identified as the sniper known as Sandman.

videos.title: Darlin', Don't Refrain
videos.overview: After the shocking developments in the Sandman case, the team works with the FBI to investigate further; while Wheeler struggles to hold onto his job, his family reaches a crisis point.

videos.title: Cecilia
videos.overview: When the murder of Pedro Hernandez is unearthed, Gibbs faces a reckoning. But when he needs his team most, the loyalty of one is brought into question.

videos.title: The Funky Bunch
videos.overview: Gibbs and Franks investigate the disappearance of a young Marine connected to a mysterious compound with a charismatic leader, and Lala’s fate is revealed.

videos.title: Who By Fire
videos.overview: When the body of a college swimmer washes up on the beach, the team must determine if it was an accident or murder. Also, Gibbs prepares for his first interrogation.

videos.title: The Edge
videos.overview: Young Ducky is sent to Camp Pendleton to shadow the team while they work a case and, in the process, he reconnects with Gibbs after the two crossed paths years earlier.

videos.title: No Man Left Behind
videos.overview: Tensions rise when Franks’ estranged older brother, Mason, blows into town, desperate for help after hitting rock bottom. Also, the team investigates the robbery of a Navy bank while Lala, still struggling after her accident, makes a decision about her future.

videos.title: Funny How Time Slips Away (I)
videos.overview:
Gibbs and the NIS team investigate the small-town death of a naval officer, but struggle to come up with justice.

The crossover continues on NCIS S23E05 Now and Then (II).

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: When an anonymous tip leads to the discovery of a young Marine’s body at a chilling crime scene, Randy believes it could be connected to a previous case where a coin was left in the victim’s throat. Also, Franks tries to track down priceless packages meant for his brother, Mason.

videos.title: Crazy Little Thing Called Love
videos.overview: The team investigates the murder of a Marine who had recently been handpicked for a classified mission. Also, Wheeler’s personal life is upended, Lala is thrown by unexpected news from Vera, and Gibbs and Diane double-date with Randy and his wife.

videos.title: End of the Road
videos.overview: When Lala’s favorite CI is shot, the team joins forces with Oceanside PD to determine who was behind the attack. Also, Franks visits his brother Mason at the compound, and Gibbs’ relationship with Diane is tested when she gets a job in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Fools Rush In
videos.overview: As the team discovers Gibbs’ drunken Vegas elopement with Diane, the newlyweds contemplate their future. Also, the team investigates a fatal movie theater bombing with a connection to the Pruitt compound where Mason is staying.

videos.title: Lean on Me
videos.overview: When a marine captain shows up at Camp Pendleton exhibiting symptoms of a fatal virus, NIS goes on lockdown and Gibbs is forced to take charge. As panic spreads, the team races to determine whether it really is a deadly outbreak or something else entirely.

videos.title: Feelin' Alright?
videos.overview: When a lieutenant’s water-logged body is discovered with a potential connection to an international smuggling ring, NIS Panama agents are called in to assist, and Gibbs comes face-to-face with an old nemesis: Special Agent Dwayne Pride. Once the two are assigned to a dangerous undercover mission together, Gibbs must find a way to move on from their past.

videos.title: The Gambler
videos.overview: When the NIS Regional Director tries to transfer Mary Jo, she reconnects with an old friend from Atlantic City to help investigate the roadside deaths of two Marines.

videos.title: Homeward Bound
videos.overview: When Dr. Tango is arrested for stealing human remains from a national park, Dr. Donald "Ducky" Mallard returns to assist the team in proving his innocence.

videos.title: The Beautiful Ballad of Gary Callahan
videos.overview: When the team's trusted K-9 agent, Gary Callahan, is critically wounded at a crime scene, NIS races to track down the culprit while a surprising pre-Pendleton chapter in Franks' life is revealed.

videos.title: Johnny B. Goode
videos.overview: Lala’s determination to get Manny out of gang life lands the team in the middle of a turf war.

videos.title: Who's Gonna Drive You Home?
videos.overview: While Gibbs and Lala grow closer on a case, Gibbs’ long-distance relationship with Diane is further tested by the arrival of an unexpected guest.

videos.title: Rule 13
videos.overview: Wheeler takes command when a car bomb goes off outside NIS headquarters. Also, the truth behind Franks’ distaste for lawyers is revealed.

videos.title: Hollywood Ending
videos.overview: With the Camp Pendleton office in danger of being shut down, the team confronts an uncertain future.
